transcript.en: Hello？
transcript.zh: 你好。

transcript.en: Oh hello. I was hoping to speak to Jack Fitzgerald about renting a cottage.
transcript.zh: 噢，你好。我想和Jack Fitzgerald谈谈租一栋别墅小屋的事宜。

transcript.en: I'm his wife, Shirley, and we own the cottages together, so I'm sure I can help you.
transcript.zh: 我是他的妻子，Shirley，我们共同拥有这栋别墅，所以我认为我能帮助你。

transcript.en: Great.My name's Tom. Some friends of ours rented Granary Cottage from you last year, and they thought it was great. So my wife and I are hoping to come in May for a week.
transcript.zh: 太好了！我叫Tom。我们的一些朋友去年从你那里租了Granary Cottage，他们觉得很棒。所以我和我妻子希望五月份能来这里度过一周的时间。

transcript.en: What date did you have in mind?
transcript.zh: 你想几号过来？

transcript.en: The week beginning the 14th, if possible.
transcript.zh: 14号开始的那一周，如果可以的话。

transcript.en: I'll just check ... I'm sorry, Tom, it's already booked that week. It's free the week beginning the 28th, though, for seven nights.
transcript.zh: 让我来查一下...抱歉，Tom，那周已经被预定了。28号的那周是闲置可租的，可以租七个晚上。

transcript.en: In fact, that's the only time you could have it in May.
transcript.zh: 实际上，那是五月份唯一能够预定的时段了。

transcript.en: Oh. Well, we could manage that, I think.We'd just need to change a couple of things. How much would it cost?
transcript.zh: 哦。好吧，我觉得这不成问题。我们只需要调整一些事情安排。费用是多少钱？

transcript.en: That's the beginning of high season,so it'd be £550 for the week.
transcript.zh: 那段时间是旺季的开始，所以一周价格是550英镑。

transcript.en: Ah. That's a bit more than we wanted to pay, I'm afraid. We've budgeted up to 500 pounds for accommodation
transcript.zh: 啊，那比我们预期的要贵一些。我们住宿的预算是最高500英镑。

transcript.en: Well, we've just finished converting another building into a cottage,which we're calling Chervil Cottage.
transcript.zh: 好的。我们刚刚把另一座建筑改建成一栋别墅小屋，我们称之为Chervil小屋。

transcript.en: Sorry? What was that again?
transcript.zh: 抱歉，能再说一遍名字吗？

transcript.en: Chervil. C-H-E-R-V for Victor I-L.
transcript.zh: C-H-E-R-V- l-L，V是Victor的V。

transcript.en: Oh, that's a herb, isn't it?
transcript.zh: 哦，它的名字是一种植物，是吧？

transcript.en: That's right. It grows fairly wild around here.
transcript.zh: 是的。它在这附近长得很茂盛。

transcript.en: You could have that for the week you want for £480.
transcript.zh: 在你想要的那一周，480英镑可以租那栋小屋。

transcript.en: OK. So could you tell me something about it, please?
transcript.zh: 好的，你能给我介绍一下这间小屋吗？

transcript.en: Of course. The building was built as a garage.It's a little smaller than Granary Cottage.
transcript.zh: 当然可以。这幢建筑起初是一间车库。它比Granary Cottage小一些。

transcript.en: So that must sleep two people, as well?
transcript.zh: 那一定也能住下两个人吧？

transcript.en: That's right. There's a double bedroom.
transcript.zh: 是的，有一间双人卧室。

transcript.en: Does it have a garden?
transcript.zh: 它带花园吗？

transcript.en: Yes, you get to it from the living room through French doors,and we provide two deckchairs.
transcript.zh: 是的，你从客厅穿过一道法式玻璃门就可以到达花园了。并且我们配备两张躺椅。

transcript.en: We hope to build a patio in the near future,but I wouldn't like to guarantee it'll be finished by May.
transcript.zh: 我们希望在不久的将来建一个庭院，但我不能保证它能在五月份完工。

transcript.en: OK.
transcript.zh: 好的

transcript.en: The front door opens onto the old farmyard,and parking isn't a problem - there's plenty of room at the front for that.
transcript.zh: 前门可以通向那个古老的农家庭院，并且停车不是问题——前面有足够的空间。

transcript.en: There are some trees and potted plants there.
transcript.zh: 那里还有一些树和盆栽植物。

transcript.en: What about facilities in the cottage? It has standard things like a cooker and fridge, I presume.
transcript.zh: 小屋里的配套设施怎么样？我猜测它应该带有一些标配的设施，比如炊具和冰箱。

transcript.en: In the kitchen area there's a fridge-freezer and we've just put in an electric cooker.
transcript.zh: 厨房区域有一台双门冰箱，我们刚放了一台电子炊具。

transcript.en: Is there a washing machine?
transcript.zh: 有洗衣机吗？

transcript.en: Yes. There's also a TV in the living room, which plays DVDs too.
transcript.zh: 有的。客厅里还有一台电视，也可以播放DVD。

transcript.en: The bathroom is too small for a bath,so there's a shower instead.
transcript.zh: 浴室太小，不能泡澡，所以换成了淋浴。

transcript.en: I think a lot of people prefer that nowadays,anyway.
transcript.zh: 我想现在很多人都喜欢这种方式。

transcript.en: It's more environmentally friendly,isn't it? Unless you spend half the day in it!
transcript.zh: 这样更环保，不是吗？除非你花半天时间在里面！

transcript.en: Exactly.
transcript.zh: 没错。

transcript.en: What about heating? It sometimes gets quite cool at that time of year.
transcript.zh: 暖气怎么样？一年中的那个时候天气有时会很冷。

transcript.en: There's central heating,and if you want to light a fire,there's a stove.
transcript.zh: 有中央暖气，如果你想生火的话，有一个炉子。

transcript.en: We can  provide all the wood you need for it.
transcript.zh: 我们可以提供你所需要的木材。

transcript.en: It smells so much nicer than coal, and it makes the room very cosy - we've got one in our own house.
transcript.zh: 它闻起来比煤好得多，而且它使房间非常舒适——我们自己家里也安装了一个。

transcript.en: That sounds very pleasant.Perhaps we should come in the winter, to make the most of it!
transcript.zh: 听起来真的很好。也许我们应该在冬天的时候来，充分利用它！

transcript.en: Yes, we find we don't want to go out when we've got the fire burning.
transcript.zh: 是的，当生起火以后其实我们会不想出门。

transcript.en: There are some attractive views from the cottage, which I haven't mentioned. There's a famous stone bridge - it's one of the oldest in the region, and you can see it from the living room.
transcript.zh: 从小屋里可以看到一些迷人的景色，这个我之前没有提到。有一座著名的石桥，是这附近最老的桥之一，你从客厅就可以看到它。

transcript.en: It isn't far away.
transcript.zh: 距离并不远。

transcript.en: The bedroom window looks in the opposite direction, and has a lovely view of the hills and the monument at the top.
transcript.zh: 卧室的窗户朝向相反的方向，可以看到山景以及山顶的纪念碑。

transcript.en: Well, that all sounds perfect.I'd like to book it, please. Would you want a deposit?
transcript.zh: 好的，听起来一切都很完美。我想预订这栋别墅小屋。需要支付押金吗？

transcript.en: Yes,we ask for thirty percent to secure your booking,so that'll be, um, £144.
transcript.zh: 是的，我们要求支付百分之三十的金额来保证您的预订，所以费用是144英镑。

transcript.en: And when would you like the rest of the money?
transcript.zh: 剩下的费用什么时候收取？

transcript.en: You're coming in May,so the last day of March, please.
transcript.zh: 你将在五月份过来，所以请在三月的最后一天支付。

transcript.en: Fine.
transcript.zh: 好的

transcript.en: Excellent.Could I just take your details ...
transcript.zh: 太好了！我能记录一下你的个人信息吗？
